svg.title: EVAGELAK EDU LAB — Silver Master Template — Step 03
svg.desc: Editable silver LEVEL 2 base with typography, level and name/footer plaques in distinct SVG groups. The center is intentionally free for the project badge and model.

g.data-layer: Outer silver border / locked in production
